notes: - The Support view failed with "Can't find variable: g": the client source is embedded in a template literal, so the regex escape `\*\*` collapsed at parse into `/**/g` — an empty comment plus a bare identifier, syntactically valid and invisible to every parse guard, a ReferenceError at runtime. Fixed, and a new release-gated scan now rejects any collapsed-regex landmine (`/**/` followed by an identifier) in the generated client scripts — the whole class, not just this instance.
